He was appointed judge of Qingzhou and promoted to censor.
推官 is a prefectural judge, and 擢御史 is a promotion to censor.
He stayed home for over twenty years and never served again throughout the Tianqi and Chongzhen reigns of the late emperor.
He stayed home for over twenty years and never served again through the end of Xizong's (Tianqi) reign.
終熹宗世 refers only to the reign of Xizong (Tianqi).
He was posthumously honored as Minister of War with the temple name Jiemin, and one son received an official appointment.
He was posthumously honored as Minister of War with the posthumous name Jiemin, and one son received an official appointment.
謚 is a posthumous name, not a temple name.
In the spring of year 7, when Qiyu became grand coordinator, Bojing was promoted Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief in his place.
In the spring of year 7, when Qiyu became supreme commander, Bojing was promoted Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief in his place.
總督 is supreme commander; Bojing succeeded him as grand coordinator.

Grand Secretary Zhou Yanru's client Sheng Shun had Zhejiang Grand Coordinator Xiong Fenwei lobby for his recall; he was made Nanjing Vice Minister of Revenue, and the Jidengs took it as proof of favor.

Grand Secretary Zhou Yanru's client Sheng Shun lobbied for Zhejiang Grand Coordinator Xiong Fenwei's recall to court; Xiong was indeed made Nanjing Vice Minister of Revenue, and the Jidengs took it as proof of favor.
為…營內召 means Sheng Shun schemed for Xiong Fenwei's recall, not the reverse.

When Shuntian vice prefect Dai Ao falsely accused Pingyuan magistrate Wang Ningming and Jiaxing investigating censor Wen Deyi of corruption, Xun praised their integrity; Ao was arrested and removed from office.
When Shuntian vice prefect Dai Ao falsely accused Pingyuan magistrate Wang Ningming and Jiaxing judge Wen Deyi of corruption, Xun praised their integrity; Ao was arrested and removed from office.
推官 is a prefectural judge.
He was soon demoted to National University lecturer for a bad recommendation of Gao Douguang as Fengyang grand coordinator, then went home on leave.
He was soon demoted to National University lecturer for a bad recommendation of Gao Douguang as Fengyang supreme commander, then went home on leave.
Bandits then seized Nanyang, Deng, Ru, and a dozen counties; the Tang and Hui princes were killed and Mingheng could not rescue them.
Bandits then seized Nanyang, Deng, Ru, and a dozen counties; the Tang and Hui princes were killed and Mingheng could not save them.
名稀 is a scribal error for 名衡; the sentence is kept, clarified wording.
Kaifeng had held a million households at the siege's start; famine and plague later killed perhaps a tenth of them.
Kaifeng had held a million households at the siege's start; famine and plague later killed twenty to thirty percent of them.
十二三 means two or three in ten.
He submitted plans for the armies, and Chen Xin'a made him Henan regional commander.
He submitted plans for the armies, and Chen Xinjia made him Henan regional commander.
Chen Zhibang and the father-and-son team Lian Guangyao fell fighting.
Chen Zhibang and Lian Guangyao and his son fell fighting.
連光耀父子 is Lian Guangyao together with his son.
The court posthumously made him Minister of War, granted hereditary Guard rank to a hundred households, and ordered a memorial shrine.
The court posthumously made him Minister of War, granted a son hereditary rank as centurion in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, and ordered a memorial shrine.
蔭錦衣世百戶 is a hereditary centurion post given to a son.
The Prince of Fu called Qian to serve as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
The Prince of Fu called Qian to serve as Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the Supervisorate of the Heir Apparent.

In Chongzhen 1, after the eunuch tyrants were killed, Shanji returned as Chief Minister of the Seal Office, became Vice Minister of Imperial Sacrifices overseeing the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and twice asked to retire.
尚寶卿 is the Seal Office; 太常少卿 is vice minister of Imperial Sacrifices; 光祿 is Imperial Entertainments.
The court posthumously made him Grand Court President, styled him Loyal and Steadfast, and ordered an official shrine.
The court posthumously made him Grand Court President, gave him the posthumous name Zhongjie (Loyal and Steadfast), and ordered an official shrine.
謚忠節 confers the posthumous name Zhongjie.
The commentators say: retired officials at home owe no frontier or communal charge; they may withdraw and save themselves—bravery is not measured by courting death.
The appraisal says: retired officials at home owe no frontier or communal charge; they may withdraw and save themselves—bravery is not measured by courting death.
贊曰 introduces the historian's appraisal.
